args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail (great weekend hike)
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I wanted to recommend the Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it’s perfect for a weekend hike. It’s about 3 miles round trip and has beautiful waterfall views throughout the route. Short, scenic, and worth checking out if you’re free this weekend.

Best,

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class at the Culinary Arts Center (Next Wednesday)
args.body:
Hi Eve,

I’d like to invite you to join me for a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week on Wednesday evening. It should be a fun, hands-on session where we’ll learn and prepare several classic dishes.

If you’re interested, let me know and I’ll share the class time and registration details.

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: Calm meditation app
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I wanted to recommend the Calm meditation app — it's great for stress relief. It offers guided meditation sessions, breathing exercises, and sleep stories to help you relax and improve sleep. If you'd like, I can send setup tips or a download link.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Grace,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM. If you enjoy fresh bread or pastries, it’s definitely worth a visit (great for weekend breakfasts).

Hope you get to try it!

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend the Cascade Falls Trail in the national park. It’s perfect for a weekend hike — about 3 miles round trip with beautiful waterfall views. Great short scenic hike if you’re looking for something nearby.

Hope you enjoy it!

Best,
